# 2 Baruch Chapter 73 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 73:2 — healing in the messianic age

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "healing-will-descend in-dew" |
| LOGOS | "healing will descend in dew" |
| PNEUMA | "Healing will fall like dew" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Descend in dew' (Syriac: nakhot b-tal) uses 'in' as a mode, not a simile; PNEUMA's 'fall like dew' makes it a simile which alters the original metaphysics of the image.

---

## 73:5 — eschatological animal peace

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "asps-and-dragons will-come-forth-from-their-holes to-submit-themselves-to-a-little-child" |
| LOGOS | "asps and dragons will come forth from their holes to submit themselves to a little child" |
| PNEUMA | "vipers and serpents will emerge from their dens and submit to a little child" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Dragons' (Syriac: tannine) should be preserved as it refers to mythological serpent-creatures, not merely literal snakes; 'serpents' is too generic.

---
